    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskSideDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fries</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wedges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the fries order size.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fries</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriesDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the wedges order size.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wedges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WedgesDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriesDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WedgesDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SideDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Drink and side ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SideDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MenuReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToBurger" name="Proceed to burger preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MenuReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToBurger</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients. Status updates are given every 30 seconds while preparing.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToBurger</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_StatusUpdate" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusUpdate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerED_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusUpdate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven" name="Status update given">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DeliverViaConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerChoice == 'menu'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ToBurger">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerChoice == 'burger only'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSide" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideDone" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sideChoice == 'fries'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sideChoice == 'wedges'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideDone" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuReady" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ToBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_ToBurger" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverViaConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" sourceRef="Task_DeliverViaConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdate" sourceRef="Timer_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusDone" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says an actor asks the customer a question whose alternative answers lead to different subsequent steps (for example, choosing between two options), and the answer determines which activities follow: Model the question as a task performed by the actor it names, followed by an exclusive gateway labelled with that question. Give each stated answer its own conditional outgoing flow that leads to the activities for that answer. Do not model the question as a plain sequence step that is followed by all alternative activities, and do not omit the gateway that routes on the answer.
rules.situation: the description says an actor asks the customer a question whose alternative answers lead to different subsequent steps (for example, choosing between two options), and the answer determines which activities follow

rules.instruction: When the description states that a question is put to a customer, and the customer's answer selects one of several alternatives that determine the following path: Model the act of putting the question as a task whose label names the selection the customer makes, using the option words the description gives. Place an exclusive gateway directly after that task, phrased as the question itself, and label each outgoing flow with one of the stated answers. Do not model the question as a gateway with no preceding task, and do not leave the selection step out of the model.
rules.situation: the description states that a question is put to a customer, and the customer's answer selects one of several alternatives that determine the following path

rules.instruction: When the description states that a question is put to a customer whose answer selects between options, and it says this happens while another activity is already under way (for example, phrased as 'while doing so' or 'during which'): Model the question as a user task on a branch that runs in parallel with the ongoing activity: split the flow with a parallel gateway before the ongoing activity, and place the question task on the other branch. Put an exclusive gateway directly after the question task, labeled with the question, with one outgoing flow per stated answer. Do not place the question after the ongoing activity has finished, and do not model the question as a gateway without a preceding task.
rules.situation: the description states that a question is put to a customer whose answer selects between options, and it says this happens while another activity is already under way (for example, phrased as 'while doing so' or 'during which')
